lines.english: Well done Nyere!
Well done Serval Cat!
Thanks to the visionary ancestors
Who are buried at Nyazonga
Thanks to our excellent Tanners
Great tanners who tan Leather soft
Great appreciation! The Hill Palace of King Saka
The Hill Residence only climbed on your knees
Any other posture is a sign of disrespect for the King
Greetings to those buried at Mt Ruunji
The Mountain where our esteemed Kings are buried
The challenging Mountain scaled only by strong people
The weak can only crawl on their bellies
The sacred, mystical Mountain of mist
Proud Ruunji people
Who only drink the best beer/water/milk
Well done, my dear MuDowe
For their goodness the Dowe are betrothed to early birds
Without MuDowe livelihoods and prosperity are never assured
Thank you our ancestors/fore-bearers resting at Nyazongo
Welcome and great appreciation to those interred at Zeramira
Thanks to Ancestors at Mt Hwahwazira
The mountain where our revered rulers rest
Thank you those in Manyika
And those at Chirowa and Chinyauzvare
Thank you, King Muponda
Well done Your Majesty! The Royal Family
Smart King of great generosity
And for whom forgiveness is a hallmark
First-timers lament for a chance to win you over
Great King Muponda of the Serval Cat Clan, acclaimed tanner
Thanks to the revered Ruler Of Doweguru
Who graciously presides over Manyika from the Lofty Uplands
For whom Remembrance Ceremonies are done under a big Fig Tree at Watsomba

lines.shona: Ndo'o pane nhoroondo, asi Dzinde riri Tanganyika!
lines.english: Where our remarkable history is discussed, starting from our origins in Tanganyika / Ruvuma
Welcome rulers at Rupinda and Mukandi
Those at Nhunhama, Ruwaka and Magoboza
Thanks to those in Maringa, Maunga and Nyanga
Those at Chidazembe and Chigodora
You crossed these big Rivers: Zambezi; Gorongoza and Rwenya
Well done, visionary People of repute
Whose mastery of stealth and camouflage makes you invisible/invincible
And a mystery to many
Thanks those buried near the Queen's Pool
Well done Your Majesty, King Muponda
My precious Serval Cat, to this Clan we proudly belong
Thank you Tanners! Nyere, Samaringa!
Is this goodness not the reason why we would rather die here?

samaringa.definition: A visionary ancestor mentioned as a fore-bearer resting at Nyazongo. Often associated with foresight.

nyazongo.definition: A sacred mountain and resting place for ancestors. A central spiritual site for the dynasty.

mapara.definition: Refers to the clan's historical expertise as excellent Tanners. 'Wangopara nhehwe dzichiota' means 'Those who tan hides until they are soft'.

saka.definition: The 'Hill Palace of King Saka'. A residence of such high status that one must kneel to climb/enter it.

dzimbahwe.definition: A royal residence or court. Also a title of respect for the King or the seat of power.

ruunji.definition: The 'Mountain of Mist' (Gomo ringobuda mhute). The burial place of Kings. It is described as a challenging climb.

mudowe.definition: A praise name or term of endearment for a provider/sustainer in the family. Essential for prosperity.

manyika.definition: The region where the Muponda Dynasty settled. The Kings are described as ruling Manyika from the 'Lofty Uplands'.

muponda.definition: The titular head of the dynasty. Praised for generosity ('Wangopa ngemwoyo wese') and forgiveness.

watsomba.definition: A specific location featuring a big Fig Tree (Mutsamvu) where remembrance ceremonies are held.

tanganyika.definition: The place of origin (The Root/Dzinde). Modern-day Tanzania/Ruvuma region.

rivers.definition: The great rivers crossed during the migration south. Kasambavezi is the Zambezi River.
